messages:
Priya: Dropping a quick thread for the vectors export modal — focused on truncation behavior, per-file chunking + zip, and rerank metadata columns. mock: https://figma.com/file/abcd
Priya: Main UX questions: default to full-text export or truncated? how to surface per-file limits? filename pattern?
Noah - Eng: Backend can stream CSV/JSONL and output multiple files + then zip. We can set per-file row limit (e.g., 10k rows) and auto-split. Need a small flag to gzip each file.
Noah - Eng: Perf note: streaming + webworker for client-side zipping to avoid blocking main thread.
Riley (PM): Product preference: default to full export for fidelity. But warn upfront and let users opt into 'truncate long text columns (preview only)'. Also add an explicit checkbox 'Split into multiple files automatically' (on by default).
Samira - Accessibility: A few quick nits: the modal must trap focus, export progress should announce to SRs (aria-live polite), and any file list needs keyboard focusability. Also aria-describedby on limit text.
Priya: Good. For copy options I drafted two headers: A) 'Download embeddings (CSV / JSONL) — includes id, values, and optional source.' B) 'Export vector rows — choose columns, format, and chunking.' Thoughts?
Ken - Data: For reranking folks, include a toggle 'Include rerank metadata' that adds columns: rerank_rank, rerank_score, rerank_model. This should be off by default for smaller files.
Riley (PM): Toggle on by default for canary; make it opt-out for general. We want telemetry on usage.
Noah - Eng: Implementation: adding rerank columns is straightforward if we pass metadata flag. We'll need to map model names and ensure dimension consistency if quantized.
Priya: UI: show estimated file size under export settings — e.g., "Estimated: 10,000 rows ≈ 11.6 MB (CSV)". Update in real-time when user toggles columns/formats.
Samira - Accessibility: estimate text needs high contrast and should be read by SRs after toggling options (aria-live).
Priya: Filename proposal: <dataset>-vectors-<model>-YYYYMMDD[.partN].extension — show preview of filename and allow edit.
Noah - Eng: Good. For parts we can append .part1, .part2 before zipping. Also support .gz if user chooses compression.
Priya: About truncation: I propose preview in-table truncation (show 'Show full' inline) but export full by default. Add a warning if any single cell exceeds 1MB with option 'Truncate large fields to X chars before export'.
Ken - Data: Warn if embedding dimension mismatch exists across selected rows — either normalize or fail export. Prefer fail with clear error listing offending rows.
Samira - Accessibility: Tooltips for column descriptions must be accessible (focusable, role='tooltip', ESC to dismiss). Provide keyboard shortcut hints (e.g., press ? for shortcuts).
Riley (PM): Copy for 'split files' checkbox: 'Automatically split exports into multiple files to avoid huge downloads.' Samira — suggestions to make it clearer?
Samira - Accessibility: Add aria-describedby linking to a more-detailed help element that explains splitting and accessibility implications.
Priya: Small UI detail: selection behavior — bulk-select (all rows) should show a confirmation if selection > 50k rows with clear estimate and time to prepare.
Noah - Eng: We'll queue large exports and show a progress modal with ETA. Backend ticket created INF-8240 for streaming + gzip + parting.
Priya: Final design asks before I update figma: - pick header copy (A or B) - confirm rerank columns toggle default - confirm file naming preview + edit - ensure aria-live + aria-describedby ids - show estimated size + per-file limit text - provide confirmation flow for huge exports
Riley (PM): Let's go with header A for clarity. Rerank toggle on by default for canary, off for general. File naming preview editable. Prioritize accessibility bits for sprint.
Ken - Data: I'll add a note to the export docs about rerank columns and dimension checks.
Priya: Thanks all. I'll push figma updates and open a follow-up thread with copy locked. :rocket:
deploy-bot: snapshot uploaded https://redwood.design/snapshots/1767123456
Samira - Accessibility: assigning export modal audit to myself (will include keyboard flows and SR announcements).
Noah - Eng: logging INF-8240 and will link PR once started
Riley (PM): thanks team :thumbsup:
